[SERVICE DOMAIN: Claim Administration] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Product Specific Fulfillment Anidado : Consumer Services (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) The claim administration Service Domain implements the payment and support obligations of the policy in respect to a verified claim
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Administer Asset Type : Claim Processing Generic Artifact : Administrative Plan Control Record : Claim Processing Administrative Plan
ESTRUCTURA DEL CONTROL RECORD (Claim Processing Administrative Plan Instance Record, 14 atributos) Claim Administration Identification | Claim Reference | Policy Reference | Product Type | Claimant Reference | Beneficiary or Payee Reference | Service Provider Reference | Internal Actor Reference | Claim Administration Status | Claim Stage | Start Date | Last Updated Date | SLA or Processing Timeline | Instance Record Identification
BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (5) Administration (12 atributos) Documentation (11 atributos) Negotiation (13 atributos) Communication (12 atributos) Disbursement (13 atributos)
